Where the only sound you'll hear is your own heart pounding as you race through forests, lakes, mountains and dungeonous mazes in an attempt to restore peace to the land of Hyrule. Along the way you'll be challenged by Tektites, Wizzrobes and an endless array of ruthless creatures who'll stop at nothing to prevent you from finding the lost fragments of the Triforce of Wisdom. But don't despair. With a little luck and a lot of courage, you'll conquer your adversaries, unite the Triforce fragments and unravel the mystery of THE LEGEND OF ZELDA!

Explore the vast Overworld terrain of the land of Hyrule and discover hidden treasures.

Explore the mystical labyrinths of the Underworld and ward-off ruthless enemies.

THE LEGEND OF ZELDA is the most challenging video game we've ever created. To help you keep up with the action, ZELDA comes action-packed with:

MAPS OF HYRULE - use them to find your way through the Overworld leading you to the lost fragments of the Triforce.
EXTENDED PLAYING POWER - ZELDA is programmed to remember everything you find on your journey, so you never have to start your search empty-handed.

424820.overview:
Take control of Vampire Hunters Edgar and Alan Frog as they stand tall to protect Santa Carla from an evil gang of vampires and their leader, David. For the first time ever, the 1988 cult classic The Lost Boys comes to the Nintendo Entertainment System. This game was made at the request... No Demand of Edgar Frog himself... Corey Feldman!!!!

This is a romhack of Shadow of the Ninja.

441357.overview: Super Lion King is a Famicom port of Disney's The Lion King, originally made by Westwood for Sega Mega Drive, created by Super Game and published by Realtec at an unknown date (1995 or early 1996). It's also known to be Super Game's first port to be released in public (with BomberBoy, a port of Mega Bomberman for Mega Drive, delayed and eventually left unfinished in favor of Super Lion King).

448074.overview:
This hack provides a new quest for the Legend of Zelda (NES). It changes many parts of the game while staying true to the original. It features brand new graphics and new dungeons. All level entrances have been relocated, secrets in the overworld are moved, and there are many overworld surprises. A list of notable changes is as follows:

    New graphics for link, items, enemies, terrain, etc.
    New dungeons for levels 1-9
    New dungeon music
    All level entrances have been relocated
    Most overworld secrets are relocated
    Change lost woods path and clue
    Change lost hills location, path and clue
    Like-likes eat rupees instead of Magical Shield
    Many overworld tweaks and surprises
    Automap patch is applied (without hearts mod)
    Select button changes “B” item (and no longer pauses)
    Press Up+A to save from HUD
    Fix wand melee bug (see Youtube Behind the Code)
    Several refinements to the select/register/delete screens
    New sword on title screen and a new subtitle
    New in-game text (which is also sped up)
    Changed low hearts sound effect
    Changed story text
    Changed font

451556.overview: The player appears to be represented by the anthropomorphic ball with a sword on the lower right side of the screen, while the CPU is represented by an anthropomorphic red ball holding a scepter and wearing a crown on the upper left side. When the game begins, you are given a 9x9 grid that contains three randomly placed balls with different colors. Each turn, you move a single ball at a time by selecting a ball and then choosing a blank space. If you make a vertical or horizontal line of five balls of the same color, they vanish and the player is awarded ten points. After each turn, three new balls will spawn. If the board becomes too full, the game ends and a Game Over message will appear on a black background that simply reads "Конец", which is Russian for Game Over.

453498.overview:
A completely new Zelda II adventure!

Long ago, a curse was cast upon the land of Hyrule. This darkness gave rise to the minions of Ganon, allowing them to overrun Forests, Towns, and Meadows.

Deep within the forest lives our young hero, Link. Guide Link across the vast Kingdom of Hyrule, and defeat the ominous shadow!

453801.overview:
Can't get your hands on a copy of Bonestorm but want the same thrilling experience? Fear not because you now have the opportunity to tee off with one of the greats in Lee Carvallo's Putting Challenge!

Unlike the NES hack of the same name released by Garrett Gilchrist & Rani Baker which is a romhack of Lee Trevino's Fighting Golf, this romhack by pacnsacdave is a hack of Mini-Putt.

456910.overview:
Ai Senshi Nicol is a top down, action shooter. You play as titular character Nicol, as he fights through a horde of aliens to save his abducted girlfriend. Armed with only a blaster, he must fight his way through 7 levels to be reunited with his loved one.

In order to progress, you must search each stage for three crystals. Once these are collected, you're shuttled off to the next area. Power-ups are scattered through each of the stages, some have permanent effects, such as increasing the power of your weapon, while others serve as temporary armor. Along the way, you'll be impeded by sub-bosses, traps, and bottomless pits that send you to the underworld.

457595.overview: A physics-based platformer about rolling a ball to the top of a mountain, on the NES! You're going to fall, and fall, and fall some more, but it will all be worth it at the top. Just don't forget to collect 80 souls on the way up!

457755.overview: Lode Runner Mappy turns the game Mappy into an alternate version of Lode Runner. The hack changes Mappy into the Lode Runner, and the cats into the enemies of Lode Runner. The Red Enemy would be the big red boss cat. It also changes the title screen, and it removes the face of the cat from the big balloon at the Bonus Stages.

458330.overview:
The Mushroom Kingdom has been invaded by ghosts… and Mario is gone! Luigi has to go on an adventure to save the Mushroom Kingdom from his greatest fear: zombies, ghosts and killer plants. For no apparent reason, Waluigi has decided to help him in his endeavours… for better or worse.

Luigi’s Chronicles was released by Googie back in 2005. This 2022 Co-Op version features reworked levels by Nesdraug to make the game easier and beatable with two players. It does not feature multiple endings like Googie’s original hack.

This hack also features:

* Stompable piranha plants
* 50 coins = 1-Up
* Hidden respawnable 1-Ups
* Hidden 10 block coins

458352.overview:
This is a complete, 5-world SMB3 hack originally started by Googie and majorly completed by Quick Curly. It is the sequel for Luigi’s Chronicles, a Super Mario Bros. hack.

There is more than one possible path to take; it is up to you to decide where Luigi goes and how he gets there. Of course, some paths are more difficult and a few may even be more hidden than others, so it will by no means be a walk in the park! This hack is intended to be difficult, so you have been warned! Persistence is the key… or is that a Whistle?

Among the changes in this hack, many levels have been spread out among longer worlds compared to those in the original game. Pay close attention to your time limit in each level as well; some ventures are based on speed and others depend on endurance! Overall, however, this daring journey aims to be a fast-paced adventure that could result in a beaten down keyboard, controller and/or brain!

458419.overview: A strategy game based on the novel, The Count of Monte Cristo. The game was published by Fuzhou Waixing Computer Science & Technology Co.,LTD. The game's title screen also credits ESC Co., LTD, but this is just another label used by Waixing.
458419.developer: Fuzhou Waixing Computer Science & Technology Co. Ltd.

458907.overview:
The first (and possibly only) sauna game for the NES! Take part in the traditional Finnish midsummer activity of Juhannussauna (midsummer sauna).

You control Sauna dude who's heaten up his sauna to 200 degrees celsius (that's 392 degrees fahrenheit!) and celebrates midsummer by sitting in the löyly like there's no tomorrow. Accompanied with a six-pack of beer, your task is to stay in the sauna for as long as possible and rack up your sauna score.

This game was previously available as a limited edition NES cartridge released in 2016 and is now available digitally here as a downloadable ROM on itch.io. Fully playable on PAL and NTSC systems. Best way to enjoy it is to use a flashcart but NES emulators work too.

Please note that the game language is only in Finnish. Manual is available in English and Finnish.

458917.overview: Leggite Luta Livre is an arcade beat-em-up for the Nintendo Entertainment System.

462644.overview: This is an HD pack for Little Nemo, exclusively for the Mesen NES emulator. It swaps out the original sprites with HD upgrades.

462693.overview:
After announcing that Zelda: Perils of Darkness would be his final Zelda 1 hack, The3Dude said he felt his legacy was complete. But some creators refuse to fade!!! That urge for something new, that itch that only Zelda can scratch, led to one more secret project.

And thus, The Legend of Zelda: Mirror of Worlds was born!

Created in secret for months, The3Dude slowly learned how to ASM hack… Through ASM, he achieved what was once thought impossible. For the first time, there is no Quest 2. Instead, every byte of available space has been harnessed through ASM to create an entirely new gameplay system, the “Mirror of Worlds” mechanic. The data once used for the Recorder (Flute) has been completely hijacked to trigger new in-game behaviors and transformations, acting as a mysterious (SPOILERS)!

Because of this breakthrough, Mirror of Worlds combines all of Zelda 1’s Quest 2 data into a single massive playthrough, utilizing the full potential of the game’s memory. The3Dude also removed the original game’s save file wipe that occurred after finishing Quest 1, meaning that pressing Start at the credits no longer erases your save file to boot a Quest 2 that no longer exists. Now, you can keep your hard-earned save file as a badge of honor (and bragging rights, of course).

While Mirror of Worlds features an overworld that matches the size of the original game, this adventure is a very dungeon-centric, Metroidvania, and Zelda Formula-style journey. You’ll explore, uncover secrets, and search for clues leading to the next dungeon, each designed with a deliberate item progression. Some dungeons don’t even hold a traditional “Triforce” piece (replaced by the Sages’ Crystals in this hack). Instead, your reward may be a crucial item required to progress elsewhere. But don’t be mistaken. There are still eight Triforce-type MacGuffins you’ll need to enter the final dungeon.

Heart Pieces also make their return in this entry. Two are hidden in every dungeon, and if you dare to miss even one… You may find yourself unable to obtain something that isn’t required, but is very useful!

This hack introduces numerous enhancements, features, and refinements, all crafted with the same love, polish, and attention to detail that many have come to expect from The3Dude’s work.

471491.overview: 4 years have passed since the hero of Hyrule, Link, defeated Onox and rescued Zelda in The Legend of Zelda: Triforce Power. But now, the evil minions of Onox have kidnapped the 9 sacred fairies of power who keep the magic of the land safe in order to finish Onox’s duties to bring Ganon back to life. Now with Ganon back to life, he keeps the 9 fairies of power in his dungeons filled with dangerous foes, with Donna, the Queen of the Fairies trapped forever inside Ganons lair. Luckily Zelda has not been kidnapped so she can guide Link on his quest, to save the 9 sacred fairies of power, and stop Ganon once and for all, and this will be Link’s hardest challenge yet, even harder than Triforce Power. Will he stop Ganon before it’s too late?

477394.overview:
The wait is over! 40 years after the release of the Nintendo Entertainment System in North America, we finally have a version of the world’s oldest continually played board game – LION MANCALA!

FEATURES

    Play against the NES at 5 A.I. levels – Novice thru Best. No matter your skill level, find a challenging but not overwhelming opponent in the NES
    Play against a friend
    Sit back and watch the NES play itself
    Enjoy detailed and life-like animations, or just quickly have the board updated to speed gameplay

478151.overview: A backport of the PC game, The Legend of Sword and Fairy, by SoftStar.

478265.overview: An RPG based off the Chinese novel The Deer and the Cauldron.

478468.overview:
This is an unofficial backport of Vast Fortune's unlicensed Game Boy Color RPG of the same name. This title should be confused with the official, authorized port published by Waixing.

Shui Hu Shen Shou combines the storyline of the classic Chinese novel Water Margin with Pokemon, and the Game Boy Color release was one of Vast Fortune's most popular titles. The Nanjing port is considered inferior to the original game, and is also considered worse than the official Waixing port.

The game was later rereleased by Nanjing as Liang Shan Ying Xiong,

478480.overview:
The Little Mermaid, released by Capcom for the NES in 1991, is a single-player game. This hack adds a second playable mermaid, so the whole game can be played cooperatively by two people on one console. A mode where the second mermaid is controlled by the computer is also available, along with a new difficulty setting.

Two-player co-op: 
A second mermaid plays from controller port 2. Both mermaids swim, attack, carry shells and open chests independently, sharing the game's original single life bar.

CPU HELPER mode:
The second mermaid is controlled by the computer. She follows the player around, breaks off to chase and shoot at enemies that appear on screen, and works her way around scenery she gets caught behind. She takes damage, but has infinite lives of her own and does not reduce the human player's health.

NORMAL / HARD difficulty:
Hard mode makes every enemy move three times as fast and doubles the lives of every boss. The original game was aimed at all ages, so it is relatively easy, this mode will make it challenging if you play without save states.

478569.overview: A backport of the popular PC SRPG The Legend of Fancy Realm. However, unlike the original game, the Nanjing backport is a straight RPG, and not an SRPG.

478933.overview: RPG based off the Wuxia novel The Legend of the Condor Heroes.

478936.overview: Squad-based strategy game based on the classic Chinese novel Romance of the Three Kingdoms.

479025.overview:
40 years after its initial release, The Legend of Zelda is now available to play as a two-player simultaneous cooperative multiplayer game.

Player 2 takes on the role of Link’s Shadow.

Either player can pick up and use any item, and each player can select their active item independently of the other. Players share resources and health.

Each player’s Select button switches their active item without the need to pull up the inventory screen.

480715.overview: An unofficial backport of the cinematic platformer Blackthorne.

482661.overview: Based on the XuanYuan Sword novels.
